Witnesses: Šuppi-aḫšu, Karriya, Dulala, Šū-Kūbum, Abī.
Nūr-Ištar brings you 5 kutānum-textiles under my seal of a donkey, all this Nūr-Ištar brings to you.
The merchant is owed by the representatives of your representatives.
Your merchants must be well.
Do not pay one or two months.
Take a donkey with the textiles.
I gave to the tin of his hand-tin belonging to the son of Idī-Ištar for 5 minas of tin copper to the merchant.
Also, he seized him for his caravan.
Let the silver of my textiles as much as you owe to the merchant and the terms of your message come.
To Pūšu-kēn from Šū-Ištar:
After the departure, I will seize me.
Regarding the silver of the transport of Kulumaya and Imkua, 10 talents 50 minas tin under seal, 3 minas textiles sealed for 10 kutānum textiles, 17 donkeys will go with me.
I have received 1/2 minas textiles in Haḫḫum.
I will deposit every shekel of silver and I will deposit it.
Let your message come to me.
Take care to inform us.
Send 1 mina of silver to my funds.
To Aššur-nādā and Kukulānum from Kurub-Ištar:
There, let Aššur-lamassī and Azutaya entrust the textiles to Aššur-nādā as much as Aššur-lamassī and Azutaya entrusted the textiles to Aššur-nādā and let Aššur-nādā give a tablet with his seal.
My dear brothers there for these merchandise, both babtum and šaliṭum goods, both babtum and šaliṭum goods, so that you can come to your message.
If they took anything from the goods, they took anything from the goods.
You will pay 1 week from the ḫamuštum of Aššur-mālik and Aššur-mālik.
Witnesses: Aššur-ṭāb, Al-aḫum.
From Šalim-aḫum to Lā-qēpum, Ilī-ālum and Pūšu-kēn:
The terms of my merchants which you entrusted to me in Kanesh.
Take care to make the merchants pay the silver and seal it and send it to me.
Send Dān-Aššur and his brother.
From the merchant which his term has passed, pay the silver and its interest.
Do not hear me.
Their terms are due.
Let your message come.
